business_problem: Heimstaden sought to improve the work involved in letting and managing residential properties, including pricing, advertising, listing review, market feedback, and environmental-risk assessment. The information for portfolio risk analysis was spread across public sources and datasets, while employees also needed tools and training to apply AI safely in daily work.
solution_summary: Heimstaden applies OpenAI tools across vacancy letting and property operations. For pricing it uses tools built in ChatGPT Sites; AI produces virtually staged images and apartment descriptions, reviews live advertisements against company quality standards, and generates market feedback that letting teams use to adjust prices. Employees retain review and approval. In an environmental-risk assessment, Codex helped an analyst discover public datasets, clean and standardize them, run quality checks, and create repeatable processing pipelines, producing more than six million useful data rows for 20,112 property assets; the page names no storage layer. ChatGPT Enterprise supports employee AI use under security rules. A procurement platform in rollout calls OpenAI models through APIs across Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams for contract analysis and negotiation preparation; the page does not identify API or data-persistence details.

business_outcome: In the Netherlands, virtually staged property-image production costs fell by more than 99%, with estimated annual savings potential of €130,000 in that market. Codex-supported assessment covered 20,112 assets and reduced the estimated delivery effort from five people working for a year to two people working for two months. Half of employees adopted ChatGPT Enterprise within two to three months.

evidence_quotes: In the Netherlands, the cost of producing a virtually staged property image has fallen from approximately €50 to less than €0.10 which is a reduction of more than 99%.
Codex supported the discovery, cleaning and standardisation of data, quality checking and the development of repeatable processing pipelines.

The result: 20,112 assets assessed, more than six million rows of useful data generated, and an estimated delivery requirement reduced from five people working for a year to two people working for two months.
After ChatGPT Enterprise launched in September 2025, half of employees were using it within two to three months.

Its Procurement Intelligence Platform, currently being rolled out, combines workflow automation with OpenAI models accessed through APIs. Designed to operate across Outlook, SharePoint and Teams, it supports contract analysis, negotiation preparation and contract lifecycle management.
